data.notes: May’s confirmed calendar mixes Israeli rock/pop heavyweights with psytrance and techno club nights plus a few international concert bookings.

events.title: AMID(A) RHYTHM
events.summary: BAÏTELIZE presents an art-and-club night at Aria with DJ sets by ÄNO, Nachum and Sacha Dahan, framed around sound, visual works and prayer across two levels.

events.title: Decision Festival w/ Asher Swissa, Captain Hook, Pettra, Shtuby and more
events.summary: A three-room trance, techno and mainstream electronic event at Gagarin, led by Asher Swissa, Captain Hook, Shtuby and Pettra, with additional Nova Room and Red Room lineups.

events.title: Berry Sakharof
events.summary: Berry Sakharof brings his electric band show to Kav Rakia, performing familiar repertoire alongside songs not played live for a long time.

events.title: Timeless – Dash Berlin 7.5
events.summary: Dash Berlin returns to Israel for a one-night Tel Aviv show billed as a special two-hour retro set of classic dancefloor hits.

events.title: International Klezmer Festival
events.summary: The Israeli Opera hosts a multi-artist klezmer concert under Hanan Bar-Sela’s artistic direction, featuring Emil Aivinder, Avraham Schwab, Pavel Levin, The Balkania and dancers.

events.title: Itamar Borochov
events.summary: Jazz trumpeter Itamar Borochov is listed for a Tel Aviv show at Barby as part of his 2026 concert schedule.

events.title: Ofer Levy
events.summary: Veteran Israeli singer Ofer Levy brings his national tour to Zappa Tel Aviv, marking 35 years on stage with his Turkish, Egyptian, Spanish and Israeli-influenced style.

events.title: Avi Aburomi
events.summary: Israeli singer-songwriter Avi Aburomi opens a run of shows at Zappa Tel Aviv with hits including “ספרי להם הכל,” “אין אותנו יותר” and “לאהובי.”

events.title: POGROM - EXORCISM
events.summary: POGROM.TLV returns with a hard-music rave focused on hardcore and gabber, featuring OFEK b2b SH, SE, Misstaken, Beatfoot, Osiris, Schizoid Nonesense and Katnoa b2b Alexa.

events.title: Monica Sex
events.summary: Monica Sex return in their 2026 live version after their 30-years-of-“Ptzatzim Veneshikot” tour, performing with Yehali Sobol, Peter Roth, Shahar Even Tzur and Safi Efrati.

events.title: Anna Asti – Queen Show
events.summary: Anna Asti plays Expo Tel Aviv with her solo “Queen” show, billed as her first major concert in Israel and featuring hits such as “Tsaritsa,” “Povelo,” “Phoenix” and “Po Baram.”

events.title: Shlomi Shaban
events.venueName: Charles Bronfman Auditorium, Tel Aviv Culture Center
events.summary: Shlomi Shaban presents a special piano show at the Tel Aviv Culture Center with Yoni Rechter, Banai and the Tel Aviv Soloists Ensemble; Ticketmaster lists the show as sold out.
